name: Helga Klose
source:
Louise's client.

Nicknamed ''The Young Master's Royal Guard'', she is one of five maids who want to find an attractive lover for their beloved master. They often wonder what it would be like to see their young master crying with pleasure, among other things.

[From in-game profile]
